what_changed: PO-5520 (200 BL-12 boilers, originally scheduled for day 7) will now arrive either as 80 units on day 7 plus 120 units on day 21 (Option A), or as all 200 units on day 13 (Option B).

options.name: Option A: 80 on day 7, 120 on day 21

decisions_for_a_person: Choose between Option A (risks O-2205, 4 days late, late_penalty applies) and Option B (risks O-2203, 1 day late, late_penalty applies) within 3 business days.
If no decision is made, supplier will default to Option B, putting O-2203 (Elm State University Dining) at risk instead of O-2205 (Tall Pines Coffee House).
supplier_questions: Which shipping option (A or B) would you like for PO-5520?
